notes.title: Coming Soon our very 1st Interactive VR game!
notes.content: We are proud to announce that by the end of this year or if not way sooner, we will be launching our 1st [b]Interactive VR [/b]with all the characters of our Tiny Love VR and Inkawaii kingdom. We will also be giving away our 1st pilot episode of our animated series Inkawaii. In the meantime please enjoy our VR ride "Tiny Love" and get to know what’s coming soon!
